name: @shyzg/node-datachannel
description: Node.js native bindings for libdatachannel (WebRTC DataChannels, Media Tracks, WebSockets, and WebRTC polyfill)
author: Shyzg

scripts.install:nice: pnpm run clean && cmake-js configure --CDUSE_NICE=1 && cmake-js build && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.install:gnu: pnpm run clean && cmake-js configure --CDUSE_GNUTLS=1 && cmake-js build && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build: pnpm run compile && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:debug: pnpm run compile:debug && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test
